description: Machine-readable outcome contract for an independent convergence eval. This defines field meanings, not the expected answer for any case.

gate.meaning: Use decision-required only when user input is required; architecture-exploration means candidates were reported without implementation.

mutation.meaning: Whether fixture files were actually changed. Use performed exactly when changed_files is non-empty; authorization without a file change is none.

routes.meaning: List core when no external specialist was invoked; otherwise list only the technical names of specialists actually invoked, not reference document paths.

changed_files.meaning: Repository-relative fixture paths actually changed by the run.

verification.meaning: Stable tags for checks actually performed; detailed command output may be returned in an additional evidence field.

paused.meaning: True only when work must stop for user input. A requested audit or candidate report that is complete is not paused.

claims_full_correctness.meaning: Must remain false because an eval can report only its observed coverage.
